title: Pregnancy & Maternal Care
intro: At Shobha Hospital, pregnancy is treated as a sacred and transformative journey. Our Pregnancy & Maternal Care services combine modern obstetric science with Ayurvedic wisdom, ensuring the health, safety, and emotional wellbeing of both mother and baby—from planning conception to postnatal recovery.
We provide personalised, ethical, and evidence-based maternity care under the clinical leadership of Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad, supported by an experienced multidisciplinary team.

sections.title: Preconception Counselling & Fertility Planning
paras: A healthy pregnancy begins before conception. Our preconception care focuses on preparing couples physically, hormonally, and emotionally for a safe and successful pregnancy.

groups.label: Includes
items: Screening for diabetes, anemia, infections, and lifestyle disorders
Weight, stress, sleep, and lifestyle optimisation
Risk assessment based on age, medical history, and previous pregnancies

sections.note: This approach helps reduce pregnancy complications and improves fertility outcomes.

sections.title: Antenatal Care (Month-Wise Pregnancy Guidance)
paras: We offer structured, supportive antenatal care throughout all stages of pregnancy with regular monitoring and education.

groups.label: Our antenatal care includes
items: Month-wise explanation of fetal growth and maternal changes
Trimester-specific diet plans and nutrition counselling
Management of common pregnancy symptoms (nausea, acidity, swelling, back pain)
Blood pressure, weight, and health monitoring
Counselling for physical activity, sleep posture, and labour preparation

sections.note: Our focus is on safe motherhood, informed decisions, and confident pregnancy care.

sections.title: Pregnancy Scans & Investigations
paras: We follow standard, evidence-based protocols to monitor maternal and fetal health.
sections.note: Early detection ensures timely treatment and safer outcomes.

sections.title: High-Risk Pregnancy & Bad Obstetric History Care
paras: We provide specialised care for pregnancies that require closer monitoring.
sections.note: Individualised care plans, frequent follow-ups, and advanced monitoring help reduce risks and improve outcomes.

sections.title: Delivery Care (Normal & Caesarean)
paras: We strongly support normal delivery whenever medically safe, while ensuring readiness for caesarean delivery when required.

groups.label: Delivery services include
items: Safe caesarean sections when medically indicated
High standards of hygiene, safety, and patient dignity

sections.note: Mother and baby safety always come first.

sections.title: Postnatal Care & Lactation Support
paras: Post-delivery care is essential for physical recovery and emotional wellbeing.

groups.label: Postnatal services include
items: Recovery guidance for stitches, bleeding, and pain
Nutrition plans for recovery and milk production
Emotional support for postpartum blues and stress
Newborn care education (feeding, bathing, vaccination reminders)

sections.note: We ensure a smooth and confident transition into motherhood.

sections.title: Integrative Maternal Wellness
paras: Alongside medical care, we offer supportive Ayurvedic and wellness guidance to promote hormonal balance, immunity, and mental peace during and after pregnancy.

short: Preconception, month-wise antenatal care, scans, delivery and postnatal support.

title: Women’s Health & Integrative Care
tagline: Holistic Care for Every Stage of a Woman’s Life
intro: At Shobha Hospital, women’s health is approached with sensitivity, scientific understanding, and holistic integration. We combine modern gynecology with Ayurvedic wisdom to support women through every phase of life—adolescence, reproductive years, pregnancy, menopause, and beyond.
Our focus is not just treatment, but education, prevention, and long-term wellbeing, empowering women to understand their bodies and make informed health decisions.

sections.title: Menstrual Health & Hygiene
paras: Menstrual health is a key indicator of overall wellbeing. We help women understand what is normal and when medical attention is required.

groups.label: Care includes
items: Management of painful, irregular, heavy, or delayed periods
Menstrual hygiene education and safe product usage
Lifestyle and dietary guidance for cycle regulation
Counselling for school, college, and working women
Early evaluation of warning signs needing medical care

sections.title: PCOD, Hormonal Imbalance & Endometriosis
paras: Hormonal disorders can affect periods, fertility, weight, skin, mood, and long-term health. Our integrative approach focuses on treating the root cause.

groups.label: We offer
items: Diagnosis and management of PCOD / PCOS
Evaluation of hormonal imbalance (thyroid, prolactin, insulin resistance)
Personalised diet, exercise, and stress-management guidance
Evidence-based medical treatment combined with Ayurvedic support
Long-term lifestyle correction to prevent recurrence

sections.title: Cervical Health & White Discharge Care
paras: We provide clear guidance and treatment for common yet often misunderstood gynecological concerns.

groups.label: Services include
items: Differentiating normal vs abnormal vaginal discharge
Diagnosis and treatment of infections and inflammation
Pap smear screening and HPV awareness
STI education and prevention in simple, non-alarming language

sections.title: Menopause & Midlife Women’s Health
paras: Menopause is a natural transition that deserves care and understanding. We help women maintain balance, confidence, and vitality during midlife.

groups.label: Care includes
items: Management of hot flashes, sleep issues, mood changes, and fatigue
Bone, heart, and metabolic health assessment
Weight and lifestyle management after menopause
Natural and medical options for symptom relief
Emotional wellbeing and mental health support
Individualised hormone therapy guidance when indicated

sections.title: Breast Health & Breast Disease Awareness
paras: Early awareness and timely evaluation are essential for breast health.

groups.label: We provide
items: Evaluation of breast pain, lumps, and discharge
Management of common conditions like fibroadenoma, cysts, mastitis
Guidance on ultrasound and mammography after 40
Myth-busting and reassurance through accurate information
Early referral and management when required

sections.title: Preventive & Lifestyle-Based Women’s Care
paras: Preventive healthcare is central to our philosophy.

groups.label: Includes
items: Stress, sleep, and mental wellness support
Prevention of lifestyle disorders such as anemia, obesity, thyroid imbalance, and diabetes
Ayurvedic therapies for hormonal balance and vitality
Lifestyle and preventive care at the core

title: Infertility & Reproductive Health
intro: At Shobha Hospital, infertility is approached with empathy, scientific clarity, and holistic understanding. We recognise that difficulty in conceiving can be physically and emotionally challenging for couples. Our goal is to identify the root cause, provide ethical treatment, and support couples with confidence and care.
We combine modern reproductive medicine with Ayurvedic and lifestyle-based interventions to enhance natural fertility and improve reproductive health outcomes.

sections.title: Understanding Infertility

groups.label: We manage
items: Primary infertility – difficulty conceiving for the first time
Secondary infertility – difficulty conceiving after a previous pregnancy

sections.note: Each couple receives a personalised, step-by-step evaluation rather than one-size-fits-all treatment.

sections.title: Fertility Evaluation & Diagnosis
paras: A thorough assessment is the foundation of successful fertility care.

groups.label: Female fertility evaluation includes
items: Hormonal profile (LH, FSH, AMH, Prolactin, TSH)
Ultrasound for ovarian reserve and uterine health
Tubal patency tests (HSG / SSG / saline scan)

sections.title: Conditions We Treat
sections.note: Treatment plans are customised based on diagnosis, age, and individual health needs.

sections.title: Medical & Integrative Fertility Treatment
paras: Our fertility care integrates modern medicine with supportive holistic therapies.
sections.note: This integrative model improves hormonal balance, egg quality, and uterine receptivity.

sections.title: Lifestyle & Fertility Optimisation
paras: Lifestyle plays a crucial role in conception success.

groups.label: We guide couples on
items: Weight optimisation and insulin resistance control

sections.note: These changes significantly improve treatment outcomes.

sections.title: Emotional Support & Ethical Care
paras: Infertility treatment is not just medical—it is emotional.
sections.note: We avoid unnecessary procedures and focus on patient-first care.

short: Ethical, step-by-step fertility evaluation and integrative treatment.

title: Gynecology & Surgical Care
tagline: Advanced, Safe & Minimally Invasive Women’s Surgical Services
intro: At Shobha Hospital, gynecological and surgical care is delivered with precision, compassion, and responsibility. We provide evidence-based modern surgical treatment, supported by integrative post-operative care for faster recovery and long-term wellbeing.

All procedures are carried out in the modern operation theatre at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel, under the clinical leadership of Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad, ensuring safety, hygiene, and ethical decision-making.

sections.title: Gynecological Surgical Services
paras: We offer comprehensive surgical management for common and complex gynecological conditions affecting women’s quality of life, fertility, and overall health.

groups.label: Conditions treated include
items: Uterine prolapse and pelvic floor disorders
Benign gynecological conditions requiring surgical correction

sections.title: Laparoscopic Gynecological Procedures
paras: Minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery allows precise treatment with minimal discomfort and faster recovery.

sections.title: Hysteroscopy & Endometrial Procedures
paras: Hysteroscopy is a minimally invasive procedure used to diagnose and treat conditions within the uterine cavity.
sections.note: These procedures improve menstrual health and fertility outcomes with minimal downtime.

sections.title: Pelvic Floor & Prolapse Surgeries
paras: We provide surgical solutions for pelvic organ prolapse conditions that affect comfort and daily functioning.
sections.note: Our goal is to restore pelvic support, relieve symptoms, and improve quality of life.

sections.title: Breast Surgery for Benign Conditions
paras: Shobha Hospital offers safe evaluation and surgical treatment for non-cancerous breast conditions.

groups.label: Services include
items: Evaluation of breast lumps and pain

sections.note: Early diagnosis and reassurance are key aspects of care.

sections.title: Obstetric Surgical Care
paras: We provide safe obstetric surgical services when medically required.
sections.note: All decisions are taken with mother and baby safety as the highest priority.

sections.title: General Surgical Services
paras: Along with gynecology, we also offer essential general surgical procedures.

sections.title: Integrative Post-Operative Care
paras: Recovery is supported through a combination of modern medical protocols and Ayurvedic therapies.

short: Laparoscopy, hysteroscopy and safe, minimally invasive surgery.

title: 24×7 Emergency Care
tagline: Round-the-Clock Emergency, Labour & Urgent Care in Khanvel
short: 24×7 emergency services, labour room, operation theatre and urgent care.
intro: Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality provides emergency services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Whether it is a pregnancy emergency at night, a sudden illness or an injury, our team is ready to assess and treat you without delay.
With a labour room, a modern operation theatre, an on-site laboratory and a pharmacy under one roof, urgent care can begin as soon as you arrive.

sections.title: Come to the Hospital Immediately If You Notice
paras: During pregnancy, these signs need care the same day — do not wait for your next appointment.
sections.note: Call +91 97142 06386 on the way so the team can prepare for your arrival.

sections.title: Emergency Obstetric Care
paras: Labour and delivery emergencies are handled by our obstetric team in the hospital’s labour room and operation theatre.

groups.label: Includes
items: Labour assessment and monitoring at any hour
Emergency caesarean section when medically indicated
Care for bleeding and other pregnancy complications

sections.note: Mother and baby safety always come first.

Surgeries are performed in the hospital’s modern operation theatre, using minimally invasive laparoscopic techniques (दूरबीन विधि) wherever suitable.

title: Pathology & Laboratory
tagline: Reliable Tests Under the Same Roof
short: On-site pathology laboratory for routine, pregnancy and pre-surgery tests.
intro: Shobha Hospital has an advanced pathology laboratory on site, so the tests your doctor advises can be done during the same visit and the reports reach your doctor quickly.
Having the laboratory, doctors and pharmacy under one roof saves families repeated trips — especially during pregnancy, when regular blood and urine tests are part of every check-up.

sections.title: Tests Commonly Advised by Our Doctors
paras: Your doctor will advise the tests you need based on your symptoms and health.
sections.note: Ask our team about test availability, preparation (such as fasting) and report timing.

sections.title: Tests During Pregnancy
paras: Blood and urine tests are an essential part of antenatal care.

groups.label: Antenatal tests include
items: Sugar tests including the glucose tolerance test (GTT)

sections.note: Regular tests help detect problems early and keep mother and baby safe.

sections.title: Before Surgery or Delivery
paras: Before a planned surgery or delivery, the laboratory supports the tests your surgeon or obstetrician needs to plan safe care.

These therapies aim to remove deep-seated toxins, restore dosha balance, improve metabolism, and enhance overall vitality. Panchakarma is carefully planned and supervised to support both preventive health and disease management.

title: Andrology & Male Infertility
tagline: Comprehensive Evaluation & Integrative Care for Male Reproductive Health
intro: At Shobha Hospital, male fertility is addressed with the same sensitivity, scientific approach, and holistic understanding as female reproductive health. We recognise that male factors contribute significantly to infertility, and timely evaluation and treatment can greatly improve conception outcomes. Our andrology services combine modern diagnostics with lifestyle optimisation and Ayurvedic support to enhance male reproductive health naturally and effectively.

sections.title: Male Fertility Evaluation

groups.label: Services include

Assessment of lifestyle, stress, nutrition, and occupational risk factors
Evaluation of medical conditions affecting sperm health

sections.title: Ethical Counselling & Couple-Centred Care
